subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Let x[n] be a periodic signal with period N and the FS
coefficient of x[n] are denoted as ck. Which of the
following statement is true? If N is odd then,
(a)
at least two of the FS coefficient within one
period of ck are real.
(b) at least two of the FS coefficient within one
period of ck are imaginary.
(c)
at least one of the FS coefficient within one
period of ck is real.
(d) at least one of the FS coefficient within one
period of ck is imaginary.
Common Data Questions 4 to 9 
Consider a periodic signal x[n] with period N and FS 
coefficient ck.

options.text: at least two of the FS coefficient within one
at least two of the FS coefficient within one
at least one of the FS coefficient within one
at least one of the FS coefficient within one
